question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Whose story did you like best?
Did you ever write for your school's newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What does it matter? It's too late.
Suddenly, Brendan stands up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... No, it's not!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Justin doesn't sign the new student budget until the end of the day on Friday, right?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it's only Thursday! That means we still have time to save the club!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If we scramble all day to do research... Write all night... We can put out a `great` newspaper tomorrow!
nodes.text_bbcode: If we scramble all day to do research... Write all night... We can put out a [color=#e23b3b][i]great[/i][/color] newspaper tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A great newspaper...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: One that'll have the whole student body buzzing... With news so compelling, everyone will `have` to buy a copy! And if they do...
nodes.text_bbcode: One that'll have the whole student body buzzing... With news so compelling, everyone will [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to buy a copy! And if they do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then Justin will have to let us continue the club!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But how do we do that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No more vanity pieces. No more how-to guides. And yes, no more complex analyses of science fiction masterpieces.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We need to find good stories about the three things people look for in a newspaper...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Crime... Gossip... And politics!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're right! People love reading about those things! If we can write one good article about each topic, I'm sure the newspaper will sell like hotcakes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, I have never actually bought a hotcake.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan, stay on topic. I figure I'll take politics...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm dying to write a piece on what a manipulative, unscrupulous tyrant our new president is!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Edgy... I like it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll take crime... I heard a rumor that Dex is working on a new computer virus that'll hack the school website and change the school name... To Center`bore!` Hee hee! Center`BORE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll take crime... I heard a rumor that Dex is working on a new computer virus that'll hack the school website and change the school name... To Center[color=#e23b3b][i]bore![/i][/color] Hee hee! Center[color=#e23b3b][i]BORE![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, yeahhhh... Why don't `I` take crime? I bet I can find something a little more... Provocative.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeahhhh... Why don't [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] take crime? I bet I can find something a little more... Provocative.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... That leaves me with gossip, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yup!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yay.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All right you two... Daylight's a-burning...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's get out there and `chase those leads!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's get out there and [color=#3b78e2][i]chase those leads![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm just saying... Let's be honest with ourselves... We're not exactly writing the most riveting articles...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh, speak for yourself, Brendan! You're the one who's been writing a 7-part analysis on the themes of `Ogres and Elves!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, speak for yourself, Brendan! You're the one who's been writing a 7-part analysis on the themes of [color=#3b78e2][i]Ogres and Elves![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's really deep work! The ogres represent Belgians!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, you're hardly one to talk! Unless, oh wait, you `really` think the school needs to read `another` piece on 'How To Organize Your Locker'?
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, you're hardly one to talk! Unless, oh wait, you [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] think the school needs to read [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] piece on 'How To Organize Your Locker'?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, clearly, the first 15 didn't set in!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, come on, let's not fight amongst ourselves... We can all agree that maybe we're not writing the best material...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, `I` like my articles... But maybe the school doesn't really want to read another radical polemic on the appeals of Third World Maoism...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] like my articles... But maybe the school doesn't really want to read another radical polemic on the appeals of Third World Maoism...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I have `no idea` what you just said.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]no idea[/i][/color] what you just said.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, perhaps I worded things badly. I think we're all good writers here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But maybe the problem is our subject matter. Maybe we're writing about what `we` care about... Not what the school wants to hear.
nodes.text_bbcode: But maybe the problem is our subject matter. Maybe we're writing about what [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] care about... Not what the school wants to hear.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, `I` think the newspaper is great... It's just that the student body here can't appreciate good writing!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] think the newspaper is great... It's just that the student body here can't appreciate good writing!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, could you picture Zach sitting and reading a newspaper?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ha! Or what about Amanda? The one time I saw her pick up a newspaper, she thought she had to connect the dots!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Or Taylor! I'm not sure I've ever seen her read `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or Taylor! I'm not sure I've ever seen her read [color=#3b78e2][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, ha ha... That Taylor... Pretty dumb...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyway! My point is, we shouldn't beat ourselves up over it! We did the best we could... And if the students didn't appreciate it, well, that's their loss.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If only we could find some way to reach them...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Okay, maybe a little... But you know, I've just been pretty busy...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's been going on?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, you know, `The Sims Medieval` just came out... We've been playing a lot of that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you know, [color=#e23b3b][i]The Sims Medieval[/i][/color] just came out... We've been playing a lot of that...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And Dex got his head stuck in a vase, that was super funny...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We told him not to stick it in there, we told him, but you know... That guy.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, how did I forget? There was also this crazy thing with the new Principal! He...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, hey! I've got a call on another line! Talk to you later!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Sure.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, great! Love you!
Brendan takes the other call.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hello? Angie?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Brendan? I have terrible news...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: They're shutting down the school newspaper!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait... `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The next day, in the office of the newspaper club...
The three members of the club, Angie, Denni, and Brendan sit sadly around a table. Stacks and stacks of unsold newspapers tower around them...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just don't understand! How could they be shutting down the newspaper club?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, President Justin was reviewing the school budget, and `apparently` we don't have enough money to support all the clubs...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, President Justin was reviewing the school budget, and [color=#3b78e2][i]apparently[/i][/color] we don't have enough money to support all the clubs...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That `jerk!` I can't believe I voted for him!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]jerk![/i][/color] I can't believe I voted for him!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well... Actually, he's right. We are over-budget.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I don't think it's fair of him to just decide to cut the least popular clubs!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're one of the least popular clubs?
Brendan picks up a list of sales and reads it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, our last issue did only sell four copies. That's one for each of us and...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ryan?
Ryan pops his head in the door.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Gotta wrap my fishes in something!
Ryan vanishes down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... Maybe Justin's right, guys. Maybe the newspaper club is a waste of money.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, no... That `can't` be it... I'm sure the problem is...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no... That [color=#e23b3b][i]can't[/i][/color] be it... I'm sure the problem is...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, yeah! The play! Right! I `definitely` remember all about that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, yeah! The play! Right! I [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] remember all about that!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, you do? Then you remember what it's `about?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you do? Then you remember what it's [color=#3b78e2][i]about?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes! Of course, I do! It's about...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Some...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Women?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah. It's about some women.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: They're trapped on a space station in the middle of an intergalactic war.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And one of them has this huge ninja sword, and there's also this wisecracking penguin...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait... Really? That sounds `awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Really? That sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, not really! What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just... You have to admit that sounded like a pretty cool idea for a play... Do you mind if I write that one down?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, sometimes I feel like you don't even listen to me anymore.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah, I'm sorry... But I don't really remember anything about a play.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I told you all about it. I've been working around the clock on it for the last couple of weeks?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The struggles of a college girl to move on from a trauma in her past? 'Chrysanthemums in Winter'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Chrys... Anth... Eh... Wha?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's a type of flower... Do you honestly not remember at all?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, Dinah... It must have just slipped my mind.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... I suppose I'm glad that you're honest with me. We still have that.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nothing. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just... I feel like we haven't really been talking lately.
Just then, Brendan's phone rings.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ooo, it's Dinah! Gotta take this, guys!
Brendan scampers off.
Downstairs, Brendan takes the phone call.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hi, cutey!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hi, Brendan. Are you busy?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I'm playing videogames with the guys, so I can't talk `too` long...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm playing videogames with the guys, so I can't talk [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] long...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, I think I found a director for that play I wrote...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What play?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The experimental one? I told you about this last week...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh... I have no idea what she's talking about...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, come on. Fighting in tourneys... Saving maidens... Slaying dragons...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wow, that does sound better than harvesting hay...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You guys are `so` predictable...
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys are [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] predictable...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? You agree with Dex?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Knights are the jocks of the medieval world, Ben... A bunch of big, dumb guys riding around, beating stuff up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Merchants... Now those are some guys I can relate to!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... Because you're a nerd! `Nerd!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Because you're a nerd! [color=#e23b3b][i]Nerd![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Man, what is with you today?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ...Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...You agree with `Erik?`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You agree with [color=#e23b3b][i]Erik?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's great news! I should get a photo for my scrapbook!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There's just something about the rustic farming life... It speaks to me!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I don't even know you anymore.

nodes.title: Breaking News
nodes.subtitle: Can the newspaper club be saved?

nodes.text: Late one night, Brendan, Ben, Dex, and Erik are sitting around on their laptops, playing `The Sims Medieval...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Late one night, Brendan, Ben, Dex, and Erik are sitting around on their laptops, playing [b]The Sims Medieval...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I have to say, this game is `seriously` awesome!
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to say, this game is [color=#e23b3b][i]seriously[/i][/color] awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know! My knight, Sir Ben the Bold, totally rules!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sir Ben the Bold? More like Sir Boring the Boring!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uncalled for.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm just saying, who would be some lame, stupid old knight... When they could be a wealthy and prosperous merchant?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Through the calculated manipulation of trade routes, land exchange, and foreign markets, I've made the kingdom of Dexteria the wealthiest in the world!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, that's real cool... `Nerd!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, yeah, that's real cool... [color=#e23b3b][i]Nerd![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, what've you done that's so great?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My serf farmer has harvested his 1 millionth bale of hay!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's... That's it? That's all you've been doing? Harvesting hay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But... Why?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't understand the question.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What do you think, Brendan? What's the best medieval occupation?
Denni sprints through the parking lot as fast as she can, side-by-side with Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, princess... Stay with me...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm running... As fast... As I can...
Behind them, Officer Monte speeds up, getting closer and closer...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No use running! I'm too fast! I drink smoothies made of cheetah fur and missile fuel!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We might not be able to outrun him... But we `can` outsmart him...
nodes.text_bbcode: We might not be able to outrun him... But we [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] outsmart him...

nodes.text: The two of them approach the edge of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Left! Now!
Denni and Colt swerve left, rushing into the park!
Officer Monte stumbles, trying to spin around...
Colt grabs a low hanging branch on a tree as he runs, pulling it taut...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha now, you little...
Colt lets go of the branch! It snaps back, nailing Officer Monte in the face!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: `Aggggggh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aggggggh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Officer Monte staggers back, clutching at his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `NOW HIDE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NOW HIDE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt pulls Denni down into a huge, flowering bush!
Officer Monte lurches forward...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What the... Where did they go?
In the bush, Colt holds Denni close! Officer Monte paces, confused, for several minutes...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I don't get it! It's like the dang kids disappeared...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey! Disappearing Ghost Kids! That's not a bad idea for my novel!
Officer Monte rushes off. A few minutes later, Denni and Colt emerge from the bush.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... That was... `Insane!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Huff... Huff... That was... [color=#3b78e2][i]Insane![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing like running from the cops to get the blood racing, huh?
Denni spins around and slaps Colt! He doesn't flinch!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're a total psycho! I could've gotten in a lot of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but you didn't, right?
Denni slaps him again!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's not the point, Colt! You're totally out of control!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's the big deal? You're fine, I'm fine, no one's in trouble...
Denni winds up for a third slap, but Colt catches her hand mid-air!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! `Enough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! [color=#e23b3b][i]Enough![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni glares at Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on... Admit it. That was kind of fun.
Denni squirms forward, pulling closer to Colt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You inconsiderate... Careless...
Denni and Colt are almost chest-to-chest...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Reckless... Crazy...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh.
Colt leans down. Denni angles her head up. They nearly touch, their lips almost connecting...
Then Denni pulls away!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... We can't. You just broke up with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, exactly. We `broke up`. Meaning, I'm not with her anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, exactly. We [color=#e23b3b][i]broke up[/i][/color]. Meaning, I'm not with her anymore.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't want to be that girl, Colt. I can't be that girl.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Even if you `are` really super-cute.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] really super-cute.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure. Whatever. What was I thinking, right?
Colt turns and walks off. Denni stands alone in the park, watching him go...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Man... I need to figure out what's going on with that guy!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Tell me, what made you decide to be President?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, to be honest, it was my very first day of school here as a freshman. I walked onto the campus, full of idealism and excitement...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Then Travis stole my lunch and tossed me in a dumpster.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh no... Really?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yep. But I didn't give up hope. I didn't despair. I saw good people all around Centerscore... And I knew the school's potential.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I knew that it could be a great school... A fair school... A top-tier school... If only it had the right leadership!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wow, that's... Actually pretty endearing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I mean... Ahem. What's the most challenging part of being President?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... Uh... Maybe the whole thing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Seriously though, it can be very difficult trying to make everyone happy. Everyone wants different things... And they usually conflict with each other.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That and... Well, sometimes I wish the office of the President would get a little more respect.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, you know. I'm not exactly a chick maggot.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure the expression is 'chick magnet'...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That makes `so` much more sense!
nodes.text_bbcode: That makes [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] much more sense!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're... Not going to print that, are you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You'll just have to find out.
Twenty minutes later, Angie steps back into the hall where $Scott is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well? How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Actually, it went... Surprisingly well!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah! You know, as soon as I forced myself to be objective... I just couldn't stay mad.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I still don't totally like him... But maybe he has turned over a new leaf!
$Scott leans over and gives Angie a kiss!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's my Anj!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Would you describe yourself as a conniving dictator, or more of a petty tyrant?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, that's... That's not really a fair question...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, is it too mean for poor Justin Wustin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's... Not my last name...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay, let's try another one. According to `some` people, you're an evil, conniving jerk who should be impeached right away! What do you say to them?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, let's try another one. According to [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] people, you're an evil, conniving jerk who should be impeached right away! What do you say to them?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And would these 'some people' be `you`, by any chance?!
nodes.text_bbcode: And would these 'some people' be [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color], by any chance?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: My goodness, Justin! Now you want me to reveal my sources?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Does freedom of the press really mean nothing to you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, this is `ridiculous.` This interview is over.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, this is [color=#e23b3b][i]ridiculous.[/i][/color] This interview is over.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Fine! I don't need an interview to know that you're a monster!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Get out of my office!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You couldn't pay me to stay!
Angie turns and storms out!
Out in the hallway, $Scott stands nervously against some lockers. Angie bursts out of the office, slamming the door behind her!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Didn't go well, huh?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, it went `great.` And I have all the material I need...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, it went [color=#3b78e2][i]great.[/i][/color] And I have all the material I need...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: When I'm done with this article, Justin won't be able to get elected dog-catcher! Hmph!
Angie storms off.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh yeah. This isn't going to go well `at all.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah. This isn't going to go well [color=#e23b3b][i]at all.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This isn't going to end well.
Meanwhile, in the offices of the Student Body President... Justin is going over some new club proposals!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A No Pants Society? That just doesn't seem proper...
Suddenly, there's a knock on the door! It opens a crack...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hello, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh! Uh, hi Angie... What's, uh, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I was just hoping to talk to you. See, I'm writing a political article for the school newspaper... And I wanted to grab you for an interview!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The school newspaper? I thought I told you, we're cutting the funding...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right, I know. We just wanted to put out one last paper... Go out with a bang!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I... I don't like bangs in general... But I suppose I can allow one interview...
Angie settles down opposite Justin and turns on her tape recorder...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Okay... Here goes nothing!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I might hate Justin's guts...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But you're right. I'm not going to let that compromise my journalistic integrity.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll give Justin a fair and balanced interview...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's my girl!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Because I `know` he'll come off like a huge jerk no matter what!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] he'll come off like a huge jerk no matter what!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...That's my girl.
Angie kisses $Scott on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: See you later!
Angie bounds off. $Scott watches her go.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anj...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $Scott, but what do you want? I can't objectively interview a guy I hate!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, then, maybe you shouldn't be interviewing him at all...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott, I don't tell you how to plan parties. Maybe you shouldn't tell me how to be a journalist.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry. That was harsh.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, a little.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I just... I know what I'm doing, okay? And you're just going to have to trust me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...I understand.
Angie turns and walks off...
In the Centerscore hallway, Angie walks towards Justin's office... And $Scott runs after her.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie, wait! Are you sure this is the best idea?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Of course I'm sure, $Scott! We need to write articles that people will want to read... And an expose on Justin's evil ways will get the whole school buzzing!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But... He's not evil.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh really? What do you call blackmailing me into breaking up with you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, he's not evil `anymore.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, he's not evil [color=#e23b3b][i]anymore.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Look, $Scott... What Justin did was the worst thing anyone's ever done to me. Maybe you two are now best friends or whatever... But I can't forgive him.
$Scott steps forward and takes your hand.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Anj... I'm not asking you to like Justin. I'm not even asking you to forgive him.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I know that you're too good a person to ever forgive yourself if you sink to his level.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If you `have` to interview him... Could you at least make sure you do a fair job? You know... Stay objective?
nodes.text_bbcode: If you [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to interview him... Could you at least make sure you do a fair job? You know... Stay objective?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, yeah! You're the most popular girl in school! I'm sure you know everything that's going on!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Heh... You really mean that, don't you? There's no sarcasm, no double-meaning, no hidden insult...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You `honestly` think I'm the most popular girl in school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]honestly[/i][/color] think I'm the most popular girl in school!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Yeah! Got any good gossip?
Taylor looks around. The cheerleaders are on the far side of the store.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, okay. But I'm only going to say it once, so listen up.
Taylor leans over and whispers in Brendan's ear...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maria made out with Jacob at Hector's party, Jessica gained six pounds from her addiction to diet bars, and Nicole is secretly dating this tattoo artist!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `WHOA!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WHOA![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't tell you any of that, understand?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now get out of here, before anyone gets suspicious!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!
Brendan scrambles out. The cheerleaders watch him go...
Outside, Erik is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well? How'd it go? Did you learn their secrets? Did they bite?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No biting... But I did hook one heck of a story!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, you know... For gossip... Everyone likes gossip about cheerleaders, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What `kind` of gossip?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]kind[/i][/color] of gossip?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... You know... Like about their love lives...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like how Bryce and I broke up?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or about their popularity...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like how I didn't get voted Queen of Hearts?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or their... Uh... Academics?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like my C in Spanish!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man, I am really not winning this one, am I?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I am not going to help you humiliate me in front of the whole school, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now get out of here... And don't ever talk to me again! Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Taylor, I...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I said go, Brendan! `Now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said go, Brendan! [color=#3b78e2][i]Now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brendan sadly rushes out of the store...
And out to where Erik is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well? How'd it go? Did you learn their secrets? Did they bite?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just shut up, Erik. We're going home.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... And how about this... Uh... Clambake! And this torpedo! And these gorgeous shenanigans!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're just saying words!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Make him stop! He's hurting my head!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem! Brendan! Over here!
Taylor grabs Brendan and pulls him aside!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, I still owe you a favor for being, you know, pretty nice to me when we were stuck in that classroom... So I'll spare you the embarrassment of leaving this store in tears.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So why don't you tell me what you're really doing here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I told you! I'm shopping for Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! And this is an adorable miniskirt... And a really lovely sarong...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not to mention this great bolero jacket!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wow! Brendan actually has pretty good taste in clothes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe he's really a girl!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Maybe `I'm` really a guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] really a guy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem. Brendan. Can I have a word with you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!
Brendan steps aside with Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look. Impressed as I am with your fashion sense, I know you're not really here for that girlfriend of yours.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Dinah? Please. That girl is more leather and garters than leggings and glitter.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, nice wordplay.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But you're right. I'm not here to shop for Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then why `are` you here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Then why [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] you here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... See, I'm writing this article for the school newspaper. A gossip column to be precise.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you came here because...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: Everyone wants to read about cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, that `is` a nice cardigan!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a nice cardigan!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hootenanny!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.
Brendan picks up a hand-knit sweater...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And this! Talk about a nice...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oooo... `I` like those!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oooo... [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] like those!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stinkers!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And how about these shoes here?
Brendan picks up a pair of shoes with long, thin heels.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah would kill for a nice pair of...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hmm... That `is` a cute cami...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... That [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a cute cami...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Strapperino!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: A `what?`
As he steps into 'Trendi', the cheerleaders freeze and stare at him.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just act cool... Pretend I belong here...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, what are you doing here? This is a `girl's` clothing store!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, what are you doing here? This is a [color=#3b78e2][i]girl's[/i][/color] clothing store!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I know that! I'm just here shopping for... My girlfriend! Dinah! I wanted to buy something for her!
Brendan picks up a cute sleeveless shirt with spaghetti straps.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Like this! She'd love a nice...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They're cheerleaders, Erik! Everything they do is news!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If we just sit and watch, they're bound to do something scandalous!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now I get it!
Erik and Brendan watch intently through the windows as the cheerleaders shop.
Taylor picks up a brown dress...
And puts it back down.
Maria picks up the same dress and shows it to Jessica.
Jessica shakes her head.
Maria puts the dress back down.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh. This, uh, isn't quite as riveting as I thought...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you think, Erik?
Brendan looks over. Erik lays curled up on the asphalt, happily asleep.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Some help that guy is...
In the store, Jessica picks up a pair of shoes and very slowly begins trying them on...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, fine! That does it! I'm going in!
Brendan gets up and walks into the store!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Talk to them? Are you sure? Girls can be pretty scary... I'd imagine.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't think I have a choice, Erik. I'm not going to learn any good gossip by sitting around and watching them shop!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, I actually know a cheerleader or two. They're all right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The only question is how to approach them...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! I know! I saw a movie about this!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You should pretend to be like them... Imitate their mannerisms and customs...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That way, you can infiltrate their cabal and learn their darkest secrets!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are... Are you talking about cheerleaders or witches?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There's a difference?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... The idea's not bad. If I go in there and just, you know, shop for clothes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They'll relax around me and just casually gossip! It's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woot!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You wait here... I'm going in!
Brendan gets up, takes a deep breath, and walks towards the store!
Denni and Colt sprint through the parking lot as fast as they can...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ohmygosh ohmygosh ohmygosh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Less talking, more running!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm trying, you big, dumb...
Just then, Denni trips over her own foot and goes flying onto the pavement!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Gah!
Colt keeps running!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, princess! Every man for himself!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Don't you dare leave me!
Denni stands up... And two firm hands grab her shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sir, I'm so, so sorry... This is all a big misunderstanding!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. The old 'Jack the Ripper' defense. Heard it a million times!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You'll have plenty of time to work on your story when you're cooling your heels in the county jail!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, please, I swear! I didn't do anything! See, I was trying to write this article for the school newspaper, and...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Wait... Are you some kind of... Writer?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Would it be good if I was?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, it would! See, I just started working on this novel... 'A Fistful of Knuckles: The True-Life Adventures of Special Agent Monte'...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And I could really use a writer's help with it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, well, I'd be really happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Great! I'll expect you down at the police station every Saturday morning at 6 a.m.!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Saturday? 6 a.m.?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Too late? Yeah, you're right. Let's make it 5:30! And don't forget to bring bagels! Extra lox!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Or. Else.
Officer Monte happily walks off. Denni sadly watches him go...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, `that` was a disaster...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was a disaster...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I said `buzz off!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#e23b3b][i]buzz off![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer slams his hand on Denni's notebook, knocking it to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `HEY!` Leave her alone!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]HEY![/i][/color] Leave her alone!

nodes.text: Denni spins around! Colt's motorcycle screeches to a halt right next to her, and he hops off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You got a problem?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I've always got a problem when I see someone picking on someone half their size... Or in the case of princess here, like, a quarter.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now why don't you take your caveman friend and go pluck each other's unibrows... Or I'll have to show you why I was the three-time bareknuckle boxing champ of Boot Camp!
Spencer and Travis look at each other...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Forget it! You losers aren't worth our time!
The two bullies storm off into the park. Denni sheepishly picks up her notebook.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for, uh, sticking up for me, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You kidding? I hate those guys. They give jerks like me a bad name.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What were you doing talking to them, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's dumb, but... I'm trying to write this article on crime for the school newspaper, and they seemed like the guys to go to.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Article on crime, huh? Why don't you write about that guy who threw a rock through Spencer's windshield?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh? I didn't hear about that...
Before Denni can finish, Colt scoops up a rock and hurls it through the windshield of Spencer's truck!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, Colt! What did you just do?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wanted crime, I gave you crime!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I didn't mean that you should `commit a crime!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't mean that you should [color=#3b78e2][i]commit a crime![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, you should have thought of that `before` I committed one!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you should have thought of that [color=#e23b3b][i]before[/i][/color] I committed one!

nodes.text: Just then, Officer Monte steps out of the park! His jaw drops when he sees the broken windshield!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What in tarnation is going on out here?!
Colt grabs Denni's hand!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then... `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Then... [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Heck yeah, you do! You made out with Colt in the cafeteria!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We... We actually just kissed and... Geez, does everyone know about that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, `she's` the one that made out with Colt? Huh! Shorter than I expected!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#e23b3b][i]she's[/i][/color] the one that made out with Colt? Huh! Shorter than I expected!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's just stay on topic, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You guys are big, hunky bad boys... I like big, hunky bad boys... So, uh, why don't you tell me all the details of your crimes?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry, this flirty thing's not gonna happen. I happen to be in a long-term relationship.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wait, really?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Olga might be a crazy wildcat... But she's my thick-thighed motorcycle mama.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow. Okay. That's an image that I'm stuck with for life.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How about you, Spencer? Surely `you'll` be willing to tell me all about your criminal ways...
nodes.text_bbcode: How about you, Spencer? Surely [color=#3b78e2][i]you'll[/i][/color] be willing to tell me all about your criminal ways...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I might not be some egghead brainiac like your best friend Ben...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But even `I` can tell when a girl is just pretending to hit on me. Buzz off.
nodes.text_bbcode: But even [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can tell when a girl is just pretending to hit on me. Buzz off.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See, I'm writing this article on crime for the school newspaper... I think it might have a `Gonzo journalist` slant...
nodes.text_bbcode: See, I'm writing this article on crime for the school newspaper... I think it might have a [color=#3b78e2][i]Gonzo journalist[/i][/color] slant...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I have no idea what that is.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, Gonzo journalism is a style of reporting that emphasizes a subjective personal experience...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I know what Gonzo journalism is, dummy.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: But what the heck is a 'newspaper'?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's a... Well, you know the evening news?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Nine o'clock on channel 4 with Tucker Garrety, the `Toughest Man On Television!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nine o'clock on channel 4 with Tucker Garrety, the [color=#e23b3b][i]Toughest Man On Television![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right! It's like that, but a paper, and for the school...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Really? I've always wanted to be on the evening news...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Just like my hero, Tucker Garrety, the `Toughest Man On Television!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just like my hero, Tucker Garrety, the [color=#e23b3b][i]Toughest Man On Television![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great! If you could just tell me a little about your criminal lifestyle, I'm sure I could get you front page coverage...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hmmm... Let me see. The first crime I ever committed was when I was three years old. There was this kid in preschool, Danny Dulopolis, and he had this tricycle I really liked, and...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `NO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NO![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer slaps Travis roughly upside the head!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: `Ow!` What's the deal?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color] What's the deal?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You never reveal the secrets of bullying to the press, moron! First rule of being a bully!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because, dummy, she's going to go write it up in an article... Then some parents read it and get upset...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Next thing you know, the school's got a Zero Tolerance policy, and you and I are on the fast shuttle to Boot Camp!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh...
Spencer leans over Denni.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now buzz off, dweebette.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey! Spencer! Travis!
The two bullies stop and turn slowly, scrutinizing Denni with lazy suspicion.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: She goes to Centerscore, I think... Friends with that nerd, `Ben...`
nodes.text_bbcode: She goes to Centerscore, I think... Friends with that nerd, [color=#e23b3b][i]Ben...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I hate that guy...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, don't worry about that! I wanted to talk to you guys about crime...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Crime...?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you know... Big tough guys like you... I'm sure you get up to all kinds of malarkey!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: My uncle had a bad case of that... His left foot swelled up like `whoa.`
nodes.text_bbcode: My uncle had a bad case of that... His left foot swelled up like [color=#e23b3b][i]whoa.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm just saying, you guys have quite a reputation. Don't you want to tell me all about it? The extortion rackets? The assaults? The poor hygiene?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Poor hygiene?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: ...That's how my uncle got the malarkey.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why do you want to know so much about us, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Denni

nodes.text: Denni slams her phone shut.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Yeesh. Kind of flew off the handle there.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oooh! Those guys are always up to trouble! Maybe `they` can help me out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oooh! Those guys are always up to trouble! Maybe [color=#3b78e2][i]they[/i][/color] can help me out!

nodes.text: Denni runs towards the bullies, her notebook out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Really?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah! I bet I can get a great story that way!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: My favorite journalist, Ron Winkertons, won the Pulitzer prize for going undercover with a tiger smuggling operation...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ron Winkertons... Wasn't he the one that was found in the woods a couple years ago, mauled by a large feline?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, he... Huh. Never made that connection before.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You still sure this is a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I'm pretty sure there won't be any tiger smuggling at the park, Ben. I'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh! If you say so! Just make sure you play it safe, okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Of course. Honestly, I bet the worst criminals I end up encountering are...
Just then, a ratty old truck swerves by and parks outside the park! Spencer and Travis hop out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: A couple of mean-spirited bullies!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Talk to you later, Ben.
Denni hangs up and walks towards the bullies, her notebook out...
That just leaves Brendan! Let's see how he's doing...
Denni sits around the parking lot of the local park... When her phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hi, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni! Hey! You want to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't... I'm trying to write a great crime story for the newspaper!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, where are you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right now, I'm down at the park. I figured, you know, crimes must happen all the time at the park, right?
Just a few feet away, a small child walks along with his mother...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Mommy, mommy! I'm going to run through the park `all by myself!` I can do that because it's so safe!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mommy, mommy! I'm going to run through the park [color=#e23b3b][i]all by myself![/i][/color] I can do that because it's so safe!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Hooray for safety!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yep... It's a real hive of scum and villainy out here...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, what do you plan to do when you see someone committing a crime?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I was thinking that I could...

nodes.text: 'As I lay on the ground, betrayed and abandoned, he vanished over the horizon, cackling like a big, disappearing jerk...'
Later that night, all three students work diligently on their articles...
Denni sits at her computer...
Meanwhile, Brendan lounges on his bed with his laptop...
And in the school library, Angie sits and writes her article...
The next day, in the hallway, Angie and Denni stand around nervously... When Brendan runs up excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It worked, guys, it worked!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The newspaper is selling like crazy!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It is?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's great news... No pun intended!

nodes.text: Well! This was quite the interesting read!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro

nodes.text_bbcode: Young lady, this is a high school, not the TV news! We have [color=#3b78e2][i]standards![/i][/color]

nodes.text: So, what's going to happen to us?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, the three of you are suspended. That's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.text: What about the newspaper? Is it still cancelled?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro

nodes.speaker: Brendan

nodes.speaker: Shapiro

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But then... Who?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sure I'll find `someone...`

Lead Editor Erik Ericson naps happily at the desk...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Zzzzz...
Politics and Ponies Correspondent Amanda reviews last week's newspaper, busily coloring between the lines...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just don't understand... I've connected all the dots, but it still doesn't make a picture...

nodes.text: Dee-licious!
Eric, Ryan, and Amanda in charge of the newspaper? On the bright side, it wouldn't be libelous...

nodes.text: The next day, in the newspaper club office, Angie and Denni stand around nervously... When Brendan walks in.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well? How's it selling?!
Brendan sighs deeply... Then pulls up a seat at the table.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We've sold a total of three papers.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Three? That's one less than last week!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw Ryan wrapping his fish in some paper towels...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't get it... We tried so hard...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe the school just isn't ready for our hard-hitting journalism...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah... Or maybe we're just not really good journalists...
Brendan slams his hand on the table!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No! `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We are `not` going out without a fight! We are `not` just giving up!
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going out without a fight! We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] just giving up!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We are `not` going gently into that good night!
nodes.text_bbcode: We are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going gently into that good night!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are we dying in this scenario?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If the school won't let us have a newspaper... Then we'll just have to go rogue!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll make our own unlicensed, unauthorized newspaper! We'll go where the other high school newspapers don't dare! We'll mine the darkest alleys for the darkest secrets!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We'll call it... `The Voice of The Underground!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll call it... [color=#e23b3b][i]The Voice of The Underground![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Isn't that the name of the rebel group in `Ogres and Elves?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Isn't that the name of the rebel group in [color=#3b78e2][i]Ogres and Elves?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes, it is.
One week later, in the empty dining room of `Peppe Pistachio's Pasta`, a middle-tier Italian eatery...
nodes.text_bbcode: One week later, in the empty dining room of [b]Peppe Pistachio's Pasta[/b], a middle-tier Italian eatery...

nodes.text: Brendan, Denni, and Angie sit tied to chairs!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Please, sir, you have to understand! This is all a terrible mistake!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Oh, there's no mistake here, chubby cheeks.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm underweight...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Your little underground newspaper uncovered the web of crime and corruption that runs through this very city... Runs `all the way to the top!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your little underground newspaper uncovered the web of crime and corruption that runs through this very city... Runs [color=#e23b3b][i]all the way to the top![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We were just following a few innocent leads! We had no idea what we stumbled upon!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Oh, you meddling little kids hit the jackpot...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: An elaborate scheme to intercept the flow of diamonds coming out of the mines below Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Funnel the profits through the Prince corporation, Wilson High, and the Oceanside Obelisk...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Launder the money through Boot Camp, and hide the laundering through a triple false flag smokescreen involving a corrupt Principal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Also cheating at the Flex Games, poisoning the Mystery Mystery, and rigging the Centerscore High student elections to prevent Jane from winning!

nodes.text: That is... Extensive.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But why? Why do it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: I don't know, lady. I just take orders from my boss...
Just then, the door at the back of the room swings open! A tall, eye-patched man steps in...

nodes.speaker: The Boss
nodes.text: Hello, gentlemen.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're the mastermind?

nodes.speaker: The Boss
nodes.text: What? No. I'm just a henchman. The real mastermind behind this operation is...
The door swings open again... And Erik steps in!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why hello, fellas! Funny to run into you here!
Mr. Lumbar and The Boss immediately drop to their knees!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What?! `You're` the criminal mastermind?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] the criminal mastermind?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Funny, right? I can't believe you all bought my clueless dork act!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now then... Who wants to play `pin the tail on the pesky newspaper twerps?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now then... Who wants to play [color=#e23b3b][i]pin the tail on the pesky newspaper twerps?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Wow. That got dark.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But it looks like in the end, Centerscore High just isn't the right place for...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guys, guys, we did it! We're a huge hit!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whaaaaaaa?

nodes.text: We read about this in psych class. It's called 'denial'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Denni, I don't mean to be the bearer of bad news... But no one bought the newspaper.

nodes.text: Well, yeah! That's because they're all reading it online!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whaaaaaaa?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why not make sure that `everyone` can read them?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why not make sure that [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] can read them?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So you had this thought...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If I could just figure out who it is...

nodes.text: N... No! And how about this cheerleader who's dating a tattoo artist

nodes.text_bbcode: Boy, I, uh, sure am surprised... I just have [color=#3b78e2][i]no idea[/i][/color] who leaked this gossip...

nodes.text: Awwww...

nodes.text: Hey! You!

nodes.text: 'We lay crouched in the bushes, breathing heavily, as the lumbering footsteps of the police officer faded into the distance.'
